messages:
maria.chen: Heads-up: planning FK migration for tenant_shards -> tenants (add ON DELETE CASCADE) during Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC change window. Need lock strategy and backfill approach. Short outage acceptable but want <2min lock per shard. @oncall FYI

deploy-bot: Scheduled migration job 8912 for Tue 03:00 UTC. Lock step: single-threaded by shard unless flagged. See link: https://deploys/redwood/m/8912

dave.p: We'll need to pin web and worker images to v2026-03-10 to ensure no schema assumptions. Also create feature flag to route writes off for problem tenants.

olivia: Concern: validated FK check might scan whole table; propose run transition in 3 phases: 1) create FK DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED (no checks), 2) run async validator that marks bad rows, 3) apply CONSTRAINT VALIDATE per-shard with chunking.

sam.k: +1. For step 2 let's use the backfill tool with parallelism=8 and row_batch=5000. Smoke test query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_shards WHERE tenant_id IS NULL;

jen_w: Migration snippet (rails/activerecord):
```ruby
add_foreign_key :tenant_shards, :tenants, column: :tenant_id, on_delete: :cascade, validate: false
# then run validator job
```
I'll open the PR and pin the migration id in the release notes.

sre-bot: Quiesce plan recommended: reduce write QPS to 20% during per-shard validation, ramp back after each shard. Will run circuit-breaker if apply_time > 180s. I can trigger throttling via the traffic-shaper runbook.

prod-monitor: Add a canary tenant set (10 tenants) in the initial shard to observe FK enforcement metrics and tail latency. We'll collect query_time and lock_wait samples.

maria.chen: Rollback plan: If validation fails or locks exceed threshold -> abort remaining shards, remove constraint creation (if applied), revert app pin, and unflag writes. Who's owning rollback steps?

dave.p: I'll own immediate abort orchestration. @jen_w will ensure migration is reversible. @sam.k handle running validator stop and report.

olivia: Also schedule a preflight dry-run on staging Monday 22:00 UTC with same row distribution. Can we snapshot-explain plan for the validate statement?

jen_w: PR: https://git/redwood/PR/4219 — includes migration, validator job, and revert steps + release notes draft. I'll add explicit 'validate:false' and per-shard validate job.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Please add 'migration-lock' emoji reaction to indicate ops holdpoint when starting. Also command to start: /deploy migration 8912 --start 1765432200

oncall: I'll be available for the window. Slack thread will be primary comms, but call on pager if needed.

maria.chen: Final checklist: (1) pin images (dave) (2) open PR and include rollback notes (jen) (3) run staging dry-run (olivia) (4) deploy-bot scheduled (done) (5) SRE throttling policy in place (sre-bot). If no objections I'll mark 'go' by EOD. :white_check_mark:
